body:
## Summary

T47 item 5 (decisions #223–#225): a new ubuntu-only `internal pins` CI job runs `swarm check-pins` from project-swarm at the pinned tag `v1.25.0` (never a branch or latest). A stale exact pin on another OASIS package now fails CI. The existing `check` job is unchanged, so the Windows matrix gets no slower.

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: new `pins` job (checkout, checkout RDW-Labz/project-swarm@v1.25.0 to `.swarm-tool`, run check-pins).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: Unreleased entry.

This repo passes the check today; no pin fixes needed.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

- workflow YAML parses; jobs = `check`, `pins`; `pins` checks out `ref: v1.25.0`.

## Mutation check

The gate here is the new CI job. Injected `"agent-core==0.7.22"` into `[project].dependencies` → `library-exact-core-pin`, exit 1 (R1). Restored; `check-pins: ok` on the real tree. Known gap (logged for swarm 1.26): an exact pin on one of our packages with no vendored wheel is not checked by R2.
